title: cleyera mexicana
intro: Cleyera mexicana, commonly known as the Mexican Evergreen or Mexican Cleyera, is a plant species belonging to the family Theaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cleyera mexicana are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
